evidence.citation: “Sweep the checkout again and verify it exactly matches the pre-run state… Start a fresh, context-free runner in a throwaway sandbox… Sweep the live checkout again afterward… For an important or borderline case, repeat the blind run with fresh agents 2–3 times and report the resulting pass rate.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The required work establishes blindness, safely removes attributable leakage, protects unrelated checkout state, verifies isolation, and supports reproducibility. The extra repetitions are limited to important or borderline cases and have a stated validation purpose, so they are not materially unnecessary under the bar.
